Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling eastbound in the left-turn lane at an interseciton in Pearland, Texas, when the collision
occurred. Driver 1 stated that the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, whose vehicle was proceeding
straight through the intersection after turning from the opposite direction. Driver 1 reported a concussion and was
transported for evaluation. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat and was also present at the scene, and
both the responding officer and the other parties confirmed Passenger's presence in the vehicle at the time of impact.
The reported injury is consistent with the type and force of the collision as observed at the scene. Photographs taken
at the scene confirm several of the reported details, and the visible damage to both vehicles is largely consistent with
the described impact sequence. No inedpendent witnesses were identified. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was
known to the parties or observed by the officer. Driver 1 is listed as the named driver on the insurance policy covering
the vehicle involved.
